title: Resources
content:
# Resources

Create posts from n8n, Make, Zapier, Chat SDK or OpenClaw, generate a client from the OpenAPI spec, or move from Ayrshare, Kapso or Twilio.

import { Cards, Card } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/card';

Pick by where the calling code lives:

- **Integrations** put Zernio inside something that already runs (n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenClaw, or a bot you write with the Chat SDK). There is no client to maintain.
- **Open source** is for code you own: generate a client from the OpenAPI spec, or fork a project already built on the API.
- **Migrations** are for code that already calls another provider. Each guide maps that provider's fields onto Zernio's.

Every page here uses the same [API key](https://zernio.com/dashboard/api-keys) and the endpoints in the [API reference](/).

  <Card title="Integrations" description="Create posts from n8n, Make, Zapier and OpenClaw, or build a chatbot with the Chat SDK adapter." href="/resources/integrations" />
  <Card title="Open source" description="SDKs, the OpenAPI specification and the projects built on the Zernio API." href="/resources/open-source" />
</Cards>
